charts.title: K2-227 b: orbits around K2-227
charts.description: The orbits of K2-227's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-227 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mayo et al. 2018 (2018AJ....155..136M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MAYO_ET_AL__2018): P 13.621832 d
